title: Dragonnor's Flight
duration: Until the end of your next turn
description:
Like a sail in the wind off the peaks, your wings unfurl and snap.

While {{VOLDRA-001}} lasts, your {{deplacement|movement}} can carry you through the air, vertically as well as horizontally, and you stay in the air, even at a standstill.

{{VOLDRA-001}} ends early if {{FORDRA-001}} ends. When {{VOLDRA-001}} ends while you are in the air, you fall. When an effect knocks you {{a-terre}} while you are in the air, you fall.
